The day we moved into our first house, my husband went out to get some takeout while I was unpacking some kitchenware for our first exhausted meal in our new house, I was in the kitchen and heard the kitchen door unlock and open, I turned around expecting to see my husband... there was a strange man standing there staring at me in shock that quickly became anger, he started screaming at me... why was I in his house? I made him a cup of tea and managed to get him to agree to sit out on the side deck with me while we tried to figure out the problem together. They sold the house and moved nearby to a smaller and easier to manage single story home to care for him.
